bio_md:
# 元武宗海山 · 主要事迹

孛儿只斤海山（1281—1311），成宗之侄，封怀宁王，总兵北边，镇压海都之乱有功。大德十一年（1307）成宗崩，海山自北边入京即位，改元至大。

武宗以武力得位，赏赐无度：即位之初即滥封滥赏，宗室诸王、勋戚大臣赏赐如流水，三宫鼎立，财用大绌；又行「至大钞」以聚财，币制紊乱。他与弟爱育黎拔力八达（[[yuan-ren-zong|仁宗]]）约「兄终弟及、弟终子及」传位之约，为后来皇位纷争埋下伏笔。

至大四年（1311）武宗崩，弟仁宗即位，践约然终背约传子，元季内乱自此而始。

bio_parts_en.value:
Borjigin Qaishan (1281-1311), nephew of Chengzong and Prince Huaining, commanded the northern army and had crushed the Qaidu revolt. When Chengzong died in 1307 he entered the capital with his army and took the throne, era Zhida.

Wuzong won the throne by force and dispensed it by whim: titles and bounty flowed without measure to princes and ministers, the treasury drained, and his "Zhida notes" unsettled the currency. With his brother Ayurbarwada (

) he made the pact of brother-to-brother, nephew-from-nephew succession - the seed of a generation of succession strife.

He died in 1311; his brother Renzong honored the pact, then broke it by passing the throne to his own son.
